# Carrier parity twin

## Intent
- outcome: Derive equal graph and contract semantics from either carrier.

## Behavior
- rule: Both carriers enter one graph shape.

## Example space
```gwt-vocabulary
Given a cart containing {item:string}
When the cart is submitted
Then the order contains the item
```
